findings.description: The small glass bowl holds roughly 10 olives, but within ~1.5 s the jar contains ~25 olives, more than the bowl could have held; the jar fills faster than the pour supplies.
The steel bowl held only green olives; after one hand scoop it shows a few green olives plus several brown nut/pit-like items that were never present or added.

The bowl is refilled to full with green olives from a steel bowl that had only a few left, and then dark olives appear inside it by 06:75 although only green olives were in it at 06:00-06:50 and the source bowl had no dark olives.

A small glass dropper bottle appears on the counter beside the steel bowl, and the backsplash shifts to yellow with condiment jars and gas grates visible, none of which were present in the earlier framing of the same area; framing jumps again around 06:00 with no clear cut.
Dark olives render inconsistently as purple-brown in some places and flat slate-gray in others, with gray olives looking artificial and shifting tone between frames.
